Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.label: D'thorga Vehicles
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.description: Working vehicles of its own: the Talus tipper truck, the Ullage tanker, the Kelly drill rig, the Datum survey truck, the Busbar generator set, the Pintle trailers and the Billy field kitchen, the V-22 Osprey and the C-27J Spartan.
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.otherMods: It gives the vehicles of other mods you already drive the systems that match what they really are (a diesel truck, a jet), on top of D'thorga Vehicle Systems. Their settings are on the Vehicle Systems page.
